descriptionHtml:
Decision D6 · P1 · Daniela

Transcript / retention windows differ from UAT 3.6: archive 48 h (not 36), Nursing Home keeps 3 visits (not 2), 'Earlier sessions' and 'Most Recent' are undated, Quick Dictation boxes never expire, windows are hard-coded (make them configurable?)

Other cases of the same question (counted once): TC-16/S10, TC-16/S11, TC-16/S14, TC-16/S23, OAT-04/S19, TC-11/S28, TC-04/S10

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S27 Yesterday's recording with no write today: its row says which day it is

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Collapsed rows are labelled accurately (e.g. 'Most Recent'), so each row says which encounter it is. (TFA-92594 AC 3; TFA-92594 How it works 3)
  • U2 The physician can open Prior Encounter Transcripts for a patient, and the prior encounters are listed there automatically. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 2; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given {hospitalPatient} with a 2-line bedside transcript dated yesterday ('QA16-LBL-Y1', 'QA16-LBL-Y2'), no write today and no history

When Open the Encounter tab and look at Prior Encounter Transcripts without opening anything; then open the row

Then The recording is listed, and its label says it is yesterday's (its date), not an undated 'Most Recent'

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92594 AC 3 'accurate labeling' (T2). cp1 (collapsed): mustContain {hospitalPatient}, 'Prior Encounter Transcripts', '2 lines'; the row label is recorded (spec.manual). Judged once Q5 is settled: Pass only if the label carries yesterday's date ('afterQ5' check: '{Mon D, yesterday}'); until then an undated 'Most Recent' is reported as 'Q5 pending', not Pass. …

Where it ran: dev unit U17; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S27 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment dev · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

When nothing has been written today, yesterday's recording is labelled only 'Most Recent', with no date.

Evidence: Allure aba2e810. The result says 'known: Q5 pending'. Ledger #17 U17, dev report §4 (known gap). TC-16 Q5 is open, and TFA-92594 itself uses 'Most Recent' as its example label.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.

Plan: unit U17 (#17, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Prior transcripts: dated rows and retention. Same panel, view only; both are about which day a row shows and keeps. Distinct patients; S27's key is renamed. Runs together with TC-16/S10.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #17, U17; checked: yes): Fail vs UAT 3.6 — by design, needs Daniela — Recorded '(prior)' transcript rows have no archivedAt by design (convex/lib/transcriptArchive.ts:92-95, prototype per-stay policy, commit 4204450) and archived encounter rows expire at 48 h (lifecycle.ts encounterArchive), so a 37 h row and a 4-day '(prior)' row stay; >4 sessions are then grouped as 'Earlier sessions' (transcriptHistory.ts:39-79) and the dated rows can't be opened.
